title: Songtsen Gampo’s Journey to Find a Wife
synopsis: Songtsen Gampo (604-650), the Tibetan king and founder of the Tubo dynasty, met his wife through a complicated procedure.

fullText.simplified:
松赞干布的追妻路

    在中国唐朝时期，西藏地区崛起了一个吐蕃王朝，由国王松赞干布统治。松赞干布是一位贤明的君主，由于一直忙于国事，把婚姻大事都耽搁了。等到吐蕃治理得已经很不错了，他才决定找个好姑娘成亲。
    松赞干布一直仰慕中原文化，他听说唐太宗有个女儿叫文成公主，既美丽又聪明，于是派出了能干的使臣禄东赞到长安向唐太宗求亲。
    禄东赞来到长安的时候，使馆里已经住满了来自印度、波斯等国的使臣，他们都是奉国君之命，来向文成公主求亲的。
    唐太宗左右为难，想来想去，他决定通过考试来选女婿。于是唐太宗召来各国使臣，宣布道：“我出三道考题，哪国使臣能够顺利答出来，我就把文成公主嫁给他的国君！”大家听了都拍手叫好。
    唐太宗带着大家来到御马场，派人牵出一百匹小马和一百匹母马，然后对各国使臣说：“这是第一题。请大家帮这一百匹小马找到自己的妈妈。”使臣们拥到马群前，左看右看，比较小马和母马的毛色、长相......可是始终没有人能正确地说出哪匹小马是哪匹母马生的。
    禄东赞是牧民出身，这件事可难不住他。他请求唐太宗把小马和母马分开，分别拴在两个地方过夜。第二天早上，禄东赞把一匹母马放到小马群里，小马一见自己的妈妈来了，撒着欢儿地跑过去吃奶。这样一匹一匹放母马，每匹小马很快地找到了自己的妈妈。唐太宗微笑着宣布：“第一道题，吐蕃禄东赞获胜！”
    接着，唐太宗拿出一颗鸡蛋大的宝石，出了第二道题。这颗宝石前后各有一个洞，洞是相通的，只是通道有九十九道弯，谁可以将丝线顺利穿过这两个洞即可获胜。使臣们拿起丝线就穿，但是一天过去了，谁也没有穿过去。
    禄东赞也犯了难，他想了半天也没想出好办法，就拿出一块乳酪来吃。他偶然一低头，看见一条黑线从脚边伸出来，一直伸到不远的一个小洞里。他仔细一看，原来是一些蚂蚁排成队，将他掉的乳酪渣抬回了家。禄东赞突然灵光一闪，他小心地捉起一只蚂蚁，给它系上丝线，然后把它放在宝石的一个洞口上，轻轻吹气。不一会儿，蚂蚁就带着丝线从另一个小洞中爬了出来。
    唐太宗对禄东赞的聪明才智赞不绝口，决定再出第三道题考考他。皇帝叫来了五百个姑娘，让禄东赞认出哪一个是文成公主。这些姑娘穿着一样的衣服，戴着一样的花，看起来简直一模一样。禄东赞围着姑娘们走了几圈，发现有两只蜜蜂总在其中一个姑娘身旁上下飞舞。他仔细观察，原来这位姑娘头上戴的是鲜花，其他姑娘戴的都是绢花。他断定这位戴鲜花的姑娘就是文成公主。
    唐太宗见这些都难不住禄东赞，心里很高兴。他想：一个使臣都这样机智非凡，不用说，他们的君主一定更了不起了。于是他答应了松赞干布的求婚，希望借此可以让汉藏两族人民世代友好团结。
    就这样，文成公主带着汉族的文明出发去吐蕃，成为了历史上汉藏联姻的佳话。
fullText.traditional:
松贊干布的追妻路

    在中國唐朝時期，西藏地區崛起了一個吐蕃王朝，由國王松贊干布統治。松贊干布是一位賢明的君主，由於一直忙於國事，把婚姻大事都耽擱了。等到吐蕃治理得已經很不錯了，他才決定找個好姑娘成親。
    松贊干布一直仰慕中原文化，他聽說唐太宗有個女兒叫文成公主，既美麗又聰明，於是派出了能幹的使臣祿東贊到長安向唐太宗求親。
    祿東贊來到長安的時候，使館裡已經住滿了來自印度、波斯等國的使臣，他們都是奉國君之命，來向文成公主求親的。
    唐太宗左右為難，想來想去，他決定通過考試來選女婿。於是唐太宗召來各國使臣，宣布道：“我出三道考題，哪國使臣能夠順利答出來，我就把文成公主嫁給他的國君！”大家聽了都拍手叫好。
    唐太宗帶著大家來到御馬場，派人牽出一百匹小馬和一百匹母馬，然後對各國使臣說：“這是第一題。請大家幫這一百匹小馬找到自己的媽媽。”使臣們擁到馬群前，左看右看，比較小馬和母馬的毛色、長相......可是始終沒有人能正確地說出哪匹小馬是哪匹母馬生的。
    祿東贊是牧民出身，這件事可難不住他。他請求唐太宗把小馬和母馬分開，分別拴在兩個地方過夜。第二天早上，祿東贊把一匹母馬放到小馬群裡，小馬一見自己的媽媽來了，撒著歡兒地跑過去吃奶。這樣一匹一匹放母馬，每匹小馬很快地找到了自己的媽媽。唐太宗微笑著宣布：“第一道題，吐蕃祿東贊獲勝！”
    接著，唐太宗拿出一顆雞蛋大的寶石，出了第二道題。這顆寶石前後各有一個洞，洞是相通的，只是通道有九十九道彎，誰可以將絲線順利穿過這兩個洞即可獲勝。使臣們拿起絲線就穿，但是一天過去了，誰也沒有穿過去。
    祿東贊也犯了難，他想了半天也沒想出好辦法，就拿出一塊乳酪來吃。他偶然一低頭，看見一條黑線從腳邊伸出來，一直伸到不遠的一個小洞裡。他仔細一看，原來是一些螞蟻排成隊，將他掉的乳酪渣抬回了家。祿東贊突然靈光一閃，他小心地捉起一隻螞蟻，給它繫上絲線，然後把它放在寶石的一個洞口上，輕輕吹氣。不一會兒，螞蟻就帶著絲線從另一個小洞中爬了出來。
    唐太宗對祿東贊的聰明才智贊不絕口，決定再出第三道題考考他。皇帝叫來了五百個姑娘，讓祿東贊認出哪一個是文成公主。這些姑娘穿著一樣的衣服，戴著一樣的花，看起來簡直一模一樣。祿東贊圍著姑娘們走了幾圈，發現有兩隻蜜蜂總在其中一個姑娘身旁上下飛舞。他仔細觀察，原來這位姑娘頭上戴的是鮮花，其他姑娘戴的都是絹花。他斷定這位戴鮮花的姑娘就是文成公主。
    唐太宗見這些都難不住祿東贊，心裡很高興。他想：一個使臣都這樣機智非凡，不用說，他們的君主一定更了不起了。於是他答應了松贊干布的求婚，希望借此可以讓漢藏兩族人民世代友好團結。
    就這樣，文成公主帶著漢族的文明出發去吐蕃，成為了歷史上漢藏聯姻的佳話。

sentences.english: Subsequently, Emperor Taizong of Tang held out a gem the size of a chicken egg, posing the second question.

sentences.simplified: 谁可以将丝线顺利穿过这两个洞即可获胜。
sentences.traditional: 誰可以將絲線順利穿過這兩個洞即可獲勝。
sentences.pinyin: shéi kě yǐ jiāng sī xiàn shùn lì chuān guò zhè liǎng ge dòng jí kě huò shèng
sentences.english: This gem had a hole in both its front and back. The holes were connected, but the channel had 99 bends.

sentences.simplified: 使臣们拿起丝线就穿，但是一天过去了，谁也没有穿过去。
sentences.traditional: 使臣們拿起絲線就穿，但是一天過去了，誰也沒有穿過去。
sentences.pinyin: shǐ chén men ná qǐ sī xiàn jiù chuān dàn shì yì tiān guò qù le shéi yě méi yǒu chuān guò qu
sentences.english: Whoever can feed a thread smoothly through these two holes will win.
The envoys tried to feed threads through the channel, but a day passed and nobody was able to feed a thread through.

sentences.simplified: 禄东赞也犯了难，他想了半天也没想出好办法，
sentences.traditional: 祿東贊也犯了難，他想了半天也沒想出好辦法，
sentences.pinyin: lù dōng zàn yě fàn le nán tā xiǎng le bàn tiān yě méi xiǎng chū hǎo bàn fǎ

sentences.simplified: 就拿出一块乳酪来吃。
sentences.traditional: 就拿出一塊乳酪來吃。
sentences.pinyin: jiù ná chū yí kuài rǔ lào lái chī
sentences.english: Gar Tongtsen Yulsung also found it difficult. He thought for a long time and couldn’t think of a good way.

sentences.simplified: 他偶然一低头，看见一条黑线从脚边伸出来，
sentences.traditional: 他偶然一低頭，看見一條黑線從腳邊伸出來，
sentences.pinyin: tā ǒu rán yì dī tóu kàn jiàn yì tiáo hēi xiàn cóng jiǎo biān shēn chū lái
sentences.english: He took out a piece of cheese to eat.

sentences.simplified: 一直伸到不远的一个小洞里。
sentences.traditional: 一直伸到不遠的一個小洞裡。
sentences.pinyin: yì zhí shēn dào bù yuǎn de yí ge xiǎo dòng lǐ
sentences.english: By chance, he looked down and immediately saw a black line extending from beside his foot.

sentences.simplified: 他仔细一看，原来是一些蚂蚁排成队，
sentences.traditional: 他仔細一看，原來是一些螞蟻排成隊，
sentences.pinyin: tā zǐ xì yí kàn yuán lái shì yì xiē mǎ yǐ pái chéng duì
sentences.english: It continued to a small hole not far away.

sentences.simplified: 将他掉的乳酪渣抬回了家。
sentences.traditional: 將他掉的乳酪渣抬回了家。
sentences.pinyin: jiāng tā diào de rǔ lào zhā tái huí le jiā
sentences.english: He took a careful look, and saw that it was actually some ants arranged in a line, ..

sentences.simplified: 禄东赞突然灵光一闪，
sentences.traditional: 祿東贊突然靈光一閃，
sentences.pinyin: lù dōng zàn tū rán líng guāng yì shǎn
sentences.english: .. carrying the cheese that he dropped back home.

sentences.simplified: 他小心地捉起一只蚂蚁，给它系上丝线，然后把它放在宝石的一个洞口上，轻轻吹气。
sentences.traditional: 他小心地捉起一隻螞蟻，給它繫上絲線，然後把它放在寶石的一個洞口上，輕輕吹氣。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎo xīn de zhuō qǐ yì zhī mǎ yǐ gěi tā jì shàng sī xiàn rán hòu bǎ tā fàng zài bǎo shí de yí ge dòng kǒu shang qīng qīng chuī qì
sentences.english: Gar Tongtsen Yulsung suddenly had a flash of inspiration.

sentences.simplified: 不一会儿，蚂蚁就带着丝线从另一个小洞中爬了出来。
sentences.traditional: 不一會兒，螞蟻就帶著絲線從另一個小洞中爬了出來。
sentences.pinyin: bù yí huì'r mǎ yǐ jiù dài zhe sī xiàn cóng lìng yí ge xiǎo dòng zhōng pá le chū lái
sentences.english: He carefully picked up an ant and tied it to the thread. Then he put it on one of the gem’s holes and blew lightly.
Not long after, the ant took the thread and climbed out from the other small hole.

sentences.simplified: 唐太宗对禄东赞的聪明才智赞不绝口，
sentences.traditional: 唐太宗對祿東贊的聰明才智贊不絕口，
sentences.pinyin: táng tài zōng duì lù dōng zàn de cōng ming cái zhì zàn bù jué kǒu

sentences.simplified: 决定再出第三道题考考他。
sentences.traditional: 決定再出第三道題考考他。
sentences.pinyin: jué dìng zài chū dì sān dào tí kǎo kǎo tā
sentences.english: Emperor Taizong of Tang praised Gar Tongtsen Yulsung’s intelligence and wisdom to high heaven.

sentences.simplified: 皇帝叫来了五百个姑娘，让禄东赞认出哪一个是文成公主。
sentences.traditional: 皇帝叫來了五百個姑娘，讓祿東贊認出哪一個是文成公主。
sentences.pinyin: huáng dì jiào lái le wǔ bǎi ge gū niang ràng lù dōng zàn rèn chū nǎ yí ge shì wén chéng gōng zhǔ
sentences.english: He decided to pose the third question to test him.

sentences.simplified: 这些姑娘穿着一样的衣服，戴着一样的花，看起来简直一模一样。
sentences.traditional: 這些姑娘穿著一樣的衣服，戴著一樣的花，看起來簡直一模一樣。
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē gū niang chuān zhe yí yàng de yī fu dài zhe yí yàng de huā kàn qǐ lái jiǎn zhí yì mú yí yàng
sentences.english: The emperor ordered forth 500 young women, and got Gar Tongtsen Yulsung identify Princess Wencheng.

sentences.simplified: 禄东赞围着姑娘们走了几圈，
sentences.traditional: 祿東贊圍著姑娘們走了幾圈，
sentences.pinyin: lù dōng zàn wéi zhe gū niang men zǒu le jǐ quān
sentences.english: These young women wore the same clothes, were adorned with the same flowers, and looked practically exactly identical.

sentences.simplified: 发现有两只蜜蜂总在其中一个姑娘身旁上下飞舞。
sentences.traditional: 發現有兩隻蜜蜂總在其中一個姑娘身旁上下飛舞。
sentences.pinyin: fā xiàn yǒu liǎng zhī mì fēng zǒng zài qí zhōng yí ge gū niang shēn páng shàng xià fēi wǔ
sentences.english: Gar Tongtsen Yulsung circled around the young women a few times, ..

sentences.simplified: 他仔细观察，原来这位姑娘头上戴的是鲜花，
sentences.traditional: 他仔細觀察，原來這位姑娘頭上戴的是鮮花，
sentences.pinyin: tā zǐ xì guān chá yuán lái zhè wèi gū niang tóu shang dài de shì xiān huā
sentences.english: .. and found that two bees were always fluttering about beside one particular young woman.

sentences.simplified: 其他姑娘戴的都是绢花。
sentences.traditional: 其他姑娘戴的都是絹花。
sentences.pinyin: qí tā gū niang dài de dōu shì juàn huā
sentences.english: He observed carefully. It turned out that this young woman wore fresh flowers on her head, ..

sentences.simplified: 他断定这位戴鲜花的姑娘就是文成公主。
sentences.traditional: 他斷定這位戴鮮花的姑娘就是文成公主。
sentences.pinyin: tā duàn dìng zhè wèi dài xiān huā de gū niang jiù shì wén chéng gōng zhǔ
sentences.english: .. whilst the others wore silk flowers.
He concluded that the young woman who wore fresh flowers was Princess Wencheng.

sentences.simplified: 唐太宗见这些都难不住禄东赞，心里很高兴。
sentences.traditional: 唐太宗見這些都難不住祿東贊，心裡很高興。
sentences.pinyin: táng tài zōng jiàn zhè xiē dōu nán bú zhù lù dōng zàn xīn li hěn gāo xìng

sentences.simplified: 他想：一个使臣都这样机智非凡，不用说，他们的君主一定更了不起了。
sentences.traditional: 他想：一個使臣都這樣機智非凡，不用說，他們的君主一定更了不起了。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiǎng yí ge shǐ chén dōu zhè yàng jī zhì fēi fán bú yòng shuō tā men de jūn zhǔ yí dìng gèng liǎo bu qǐ le
sentences.english: Emperor Taizong of Tang seeing that these matters were no trouble for Gar Tongtsen Yulsung, was very happy in his heart.

sentences.simplified: 于是他答应了松赞干布的求婚，
sentences.traditional: 於是他答應了松贊干布的求婚，
sentences.pinyin: yú shì tā dā ying le sōng zàn gàn bù de qiú hūn
sentences.english: He thought: Even an envoy has this extraordinary wit. Needless to say, his monarch must be even more extraordinary.

sentences.simplified: 希望借此可以让汉藏两族人民世代友好团结。
sentences.traditional: 希望借此可以讓漢藏兩族人民世代友好團結。
sentences.pinyin: xī wàng jiè cǐ kě yǐ ràng hàn zàng liǎng zú rén mín shì dài yǒu hǎo tuán jié
sentences.english: Thereupon, he agreed to Songtsen Gampo’s marriage proposal, ..
.. hoping that it would lead to the friendship and unity of the Han and Tibetan peoples for many generations.

sentences.simplified: 就这样，文成公主带着汉族的文明出发去吐蕃，
sentences.traditional: 就這樣，文成公主帶著漢族的文明出發去吐蕃，
sentences.pinyin: jiù zhè yàng wén chéng gōng zhǔ dài zhe hàn zú de wén míng chū fā qù tǔ bō

sentences.simplified: 成为了历史上汉藏联姻的佳话。
sentences.traditional: 成為了歷史上漢藏聯姻的佳話。
sentences.pinyin: chéng wéi le lì shǐ shang hàn zàng lián yīn de jiā huà
sentences.english: Just like this, Princess Wencheng brought with her the civilization of the Han and set out for Tibet, ..
.. creating the much talked about story of the connection between the Han and Tibetan peoples through marriage.

raw.synopsis: Songtsen Gampo (604-650), the Tibetan king and founder of the Tubo dynasty, met his wife through a complicated procedure.
sentence_translations: Songtsen Gampo’s Wife-Chasing Journey
During the Chinese Tang dynasty period, the Tubo Dynasty emerged in the Tibetan region, ruled by king Songtsen Gampo.
Songtsen Gampo was a wise and capable monarch. As he was always busy with politics, he delayed getting married.
He waited until the rule of the Tubo Dynasty was going well before deciding to find the right young woman to marry.
Songtsen Gampo had always admired the culture of the Central Plain.
He had heard that Emperor Taizong of Tang had a daughter called Princess Wencheng, who was both beautiful and clever.
As a result, he sent the capable envoy Gar Tongtsen Yulsung to Chang’an to ask Emperor Taizong of Tang for a marriage alliance.
When Gar Tongtsen Yulsung arrived at Chang’an, the consulate was already full with envoys from countries such as India, Persia and so on.
They had all received orders from the monarch to come and propose marriage to Princess Wencheng.
Emperor Taizong of Tang was in a dilemma, and after deliberation decided to select his son-in-law through a test.
Thereupon, Emperor Taizong of Tang called together each country’s envoy, and declared, “I will pose three questions.
Whichever country’s envoy can answer them without a hitch, I will have Princess Wencheng marry his monarch!”
Everyone who heard clapped and cheered.
Emperor Taizong of Tang led everyone to the imperial racecourse, and sent people to bring out 100 foals and 100 mares.
Then he said to each country’s envoy, ..
.. “This is the first question. I ask that everybody helps these 100 foals find their mothers.”
The envoys all swarmed to the front of the herd of horses, looking left and right, comparing the foals’ and mares’ coat color, appearance…
Yet from beginning to end, nobody was able to correctly say which foal had been given birth to by which mare.
Gar Tongtsen Yulsung was born a herdsman. This task was not difficult for him.
He requested Emperor Taizong of Tang to separate the foals from the mares, ..
.. and tie them up in two different areas overnight.
On the morning of the second day, Gar Tongtsen Yulsung placed one mare amongst the herd of foals.
As soon as the foal saw that its mother had arrived, it frolicked over to drink milk.
In this way, one by one the mares were released. Each foal was very quickly able to find its mother.
Emperor Taizong of Tang declared with a smile, “The first question, the Tibetan Gar Tongtsen Yulsung has solved!”
Subsequently, Emperor Taizong of Tang held out a gem the size of a chicken egg, posing the second question.
This gem had a hole in both its front and back. The holes were connected, but the channel had 99 bends.
Whoever can feed a thread smoothly through these two holes will win.
The envoys tried to feed threads through the channel, but a day passed and nobody was able to feed a thread through.
Gar Tongtsen Yulsung also found it difficult. He thought for a long time and couldn’t think of a good way.
He took out a piece of cheese to eat.
By chance, he looked down and immediately saw a black line extending from beside his foot.
It continued to a small hole not far away.
He took a careful look, and saw that it was actually some ants arranged in a line, ..
.. carrying the cheese that he dropped back home.
Gar Tongtsen Yulsung suddenly had a flash of inspiration.
He carefully picked up an ant and tied it to the thread. Then he put it on one of the gem’s holes and blew lightly.
Not long after, the ant took the thread and climbed out from the other small hole.
Emperor Taizong of Tang praised Gar Tongtsen Yulsung’s intelligence and wisdom to high heaven.
He decided to pose the third question to test him.
The emperor ordered forth 500 young women, and got Gar Tongtsen Yulsung identify Princess Wencheng.
These young women wore the same clothes, were adorned with the same flowers, and looked practically exactly identical.
Gar Tongtsen Yulsung circled around the young women a few times, ..
.. and found that two bees were always fluttering about beside one particular young woman.
He observed carefully. It turned out that this young woman wore fresh flowers on her head, ..
.. whilst the others wore silk flowers.
He concluded that the young woman who wore fresh flowers was Princess Wencheng.
Emperor Taizong of Tang seeing that these matters were no trouble for Gar Tongtsen Yulsung, was very happy in his heart.
He thought: Even an envoy has this extraordinary wit. Needless to say, his monarch must be even more extraordinary.
Thereupon, he agreed to Songtsen Gampo’s marriage proposal, ..
.. hoping that it would lead to the friendship and unity of the Han and Tibetan peoples for many generations.
Just like this, Princess Wencheng brought with her the civilization of the Han and set out for Tibet, ..
.. creating the much talked about story of the connection between the Han and Tibetan peoples through marriage.
